name: manifest-non-regular-file-limits
body: Index keying preserves symlinks (content hashed through the link) and gitlinks (submodule directory walked), but two whole-tree cases do not reproduce: a tracked symlink to a directory is dropped because blob_oid_of_file yields None where the whole-tree walk followed it, and a content filter such as core.autocrlf makes a tracked file's index OID differ from its raw worktree bytes. Upgrade when a repo with symlinked directories or content filters must match the whole-tree manifest exactly.
